settings.description: Scroll through more than six weapon or ammunition entries, the perk pick row, and the upgrade columns in out-of-mission infantry and vehicle management (army presets and squad management), using the mouse wheel or separate scrollbars. Keeps the original card sizes. Lets a unit take more than five upgrades: scroll an empty upgrade card into view and drop an upgrade on it. False restores the six-entry rows, five-card perk row and five-slot upgrade columns; it does not remove inventory, perks or installed upgrades. Does not change the in-mission ammo menu or require the selection/ammunition plugins. Enable the companion Defiance squad inventory scrolling mod in the game MODS menu; disable that companion too when removing this feature. Restart required.

Most cards the infantry panel's perk pick row shows; the row scrolls when there are more than the five it shows at once. The row is as long as the squad's type has trainings, up to this. 5-20; five matches stock. Only changes how many perks the row displays and scrolls through; it does not grant perks or change the game's own perk and rank limits. Requires the companion Defiance squad inventory scrolling mod for the row's slider. Restart required.

Scroll the upgrade columns in out-of-mission infantry and vehicle management and allow more than five upgrades per unit (see upgrade_slots). As an upgrade drag starts, the column scrolls to the card the drop will land on: the installed upgrade it would replace or duplicate, otherwise the first empty card. False leaves the stock five-slot columns and hides their scrollbars. Requires the companion Defiance squad inventory scrolling mod for the upgrade scrollbars. Restart required.

Length of the upgrade columns: a unit's installed upgrades, then empty cards up to this count, five at a time with a scrollbar. Drop an upgrade on an empty card to install more than five. 5-30; default 20; five reproduces stock (five slots, no scrollbar). The game still rejects duplicates and replaces a conflicting upgrade (for example a second armor). Requires upgrades enabled and the companion Defiance squad inventory scrolling mod. Restart required.

Apply independent scrolling to the out-of-mission vehicle panel (weapons, ammunition and upgrades). False leaves the vehicle panel entirely stock and hides its scrollbars, while the infantry panel keeps scrolling. Restart required.
